def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into single spaces and strip ends.

    Preserves all other code points including NBSP.
    """
    import re
    return re.sub(r'[ \t\r\n\x0b\x0c]+', ' ', s).strip(' \t\r\n\x0b\x0c')

def collapse_whitespace(s: str) -> str:
    """Collapse runs of whitespace characters into one ASCII space and strip
    only those characters at both ends.

    The characters collapsed are: space (0x20), tab (0x09), LF (0x0A),
    CR (0x0D), vertical tab (0x0B), form feed (0x0C).  All other code
    points, including NBSP, are preserved unchanged.
    """
    result = []
    prev_was_collapsed = False

    for ch in s:
        # Check if character is one of the target whitespace codes
        if ch in (" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\x0b", "\x0c"):
            if not prev_was_collapsed:
                result.append(" ")
                prev_was_collapsed = True
        else:
            result.append(ch)
            prev_was_collapsed = False

    # Strip leading and trailing ASCII spaces added by collapsing
    # Convert to string and use strip to remove only ASCII space
    collapsed = "".join(result)
    return collapsed.strip(" ")
